usage: Used for a tree branch or any branching part of a plant. In everyday Cantonese, 枝 is a very common basic noun.
Often pairs with measure words like 一枝 / 幾枝 when counting long, thin things; for plants, it can also refer to a branch you can see and point at directly.
In gardening talk, 枝 is neutral and simple, so it fits well in descriptions of pruning, broken branches, or parts growing out from a trunk.
Learners should remember that 枝 is not the same as 樹枝 in many contexts; 枝 is shorter and more general, while 樹枝 makes the meaning more explicit.
